statement: ∀ (n B D T : ℕ) (P : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), (∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → m ≤ B*D → m.divisors.card ≤ T) → (∀ p : ℕ, c p 0 = 0) → (∀ p ∈ P, ∀ a ≤ B, ‖c p a‖ ≤ M) → let e := fun (k : ℤ) (t : ℝ) => Complex.exp (((k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * (t : ℂ)); let R := fun (p : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (B+1), c p j * e (j : ℤ) ((p : ℝ)*t); let pairs := (P.product P).filter (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => |(z.1 : ℤ) - z.2| ≤ D); ‖intervalIntegral (fun t => (∑ z ∈ pairs, R z.1 t * R z.2 t) * e (-(n : ℤ)) t) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume‖ ≤ ((min (B^2*(2*D+1)) (B^2 + 2*B*(2*D+1)*T) : ℕ) : ℝ) * M^2

plain_statement.zh: 用因子数控制 Type-II 全圆系数中相距至多 D 的余因子对
plain_statement.en: Bound close cofactor pairs in a full-circle Type-II coefficient by divisor counts

brief.zh: 对每个固定 n，令正短因子 a,b≤B，余因子 p,q 来自同一有限集，且 |p−q|≤D。T 控制 1 到 BD 内各整数的因子个数。在已有 B²(2D+1)M² 界外，证明同一系数还至多为 (B²+2B(2D+1)T)M²。对角 p=q 单独计数。对 p≠q 固定 s=a+b 及 p，则 p 距 ⌊n/s⌋ 至多 D，且 b 是非零整数 |n−sp| 的因子。第一带中可取 D=⌊n^(5/8)⌋。可引用全站已验模块。
brief.en: Fix the target n, positive short factors a,b≤B, and cofactors p,q in the same finite set with |p−q|≤D. Let T bound divisor counts on [1,BD]. In addition to the existing B²(2D+1)M² bound, prove (B²+2B(2D+1)T)M² for the same coefficient. Count p=q separately. For p≠q, fix s=a+b and p. The endpoint p is within D of floor(n/s), and b divides the nonzero integer |n−sp|. The first band admits D=floor(n^(5/8)). Verified modules from any desk may be used.
